correctness.rationale: The symbolic determinants are exact for all strictly positive real parameters. Cauchy interlacing after deleting node 3 yields lambda_2(M_A)<=a, while Perron strict monotonicity gives lambda_B>a. Thus the sign of P_A(lambda_B) is precisely the sign of lambda_B-lambda_A. Its factored negative expression yields the claimed sign formula; t lambda_B(t) rises strictly from 0 to infinity and establishes the iff condition, unique positive crossover, all ties and no-crossover cases. The code independently checked 2577 symbolic/exact/numeric assertions. Proof does not depend on finite enumeration.

value.rationale: The four-node path is the minimal chain with two distinct missing distance-two corridors. Restoration must choose between finite-budget alternatives, and first-order eigenvalue sensitivities can select the corridor that later becomes suboptimal. The theorem gives a complete parameter-level one-switch classification for a motivated network capacity proxy, including a sharp physical threshold and a nontrivial rejection of a spurious algebraic root; this is not merely an arbitrary numerical example or a routine substitution. It does not purport to solve empirical management optimization.
